title: MSHA - ISIB Gas Analyzer
agency: LABOR, DEPARTMENT OF.OFFICE OF THE ASSISTANT SECRETARY FOR ADMINISTRATION AND MANAGEMENT.DOL - CAS DIVISION 4 PROCUREMENT
description_text: CAI Model 701LX NDIR Gas Analyzer or Equivalent The Government requires a California Analytical Instruments, Inc. Model 701LX NDIR gas analyzer. The Government is currently operating an intrinsic safety approval laboratory using outdated and/or deteriorated gas analyzing equipment. This equipment is used in the approval of mining equipment which is instrumental to the safety of miners.
